RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

Because both you and the successful candidate are men, it is extremely unlikely that sex discrimination influenced the choice between the two of you. Raising the panel’s all-male composition will appear unfounded and detract from your credibility.

An all-male panel may reflect poor diversity governance, but it provides no legal or practical leverage in your case. Instead, focus on substantive qualifications: your master’s degree in educational leadership and five years as deputy principal compared to the appointee’s lack of a leadership degree and administrative experience. Follow up firmly on your overdue request for a written explanation, framing your inquiry around merit, criteria weighting, and procedural fairness.
